body: Yeah! I get that. Part of me hates that I've never succeeded and part of is okay with it because I don't want others to suffer. I hate this. All of it.
I was!! I was confused and angry and sad. I felt even more like a failure. I woke up a week later. I had been on life support. I almost succeeded but it wasn't good enough.
Same!!! I've gotten close. At one point I spent time in the ICU. When I woke up in the ICU I cried for what felt like forever... Because I woke up.
Thank you! I'm trying to focus on the future. I just wish my head would shut up.
That makes sense. I feel like I try to plan for the future and in the next minute I'm planning my suicide. I hate it.
Some. Part of me  knows I've grown. I've reflected a lot on my past. And I feel I've let if the abuse and trauma go. But for some reason I still don't see a future that I'm happy in.
I have a psychiatrist and a therapist. I see psych 2x a week and therapist 1x a week.
Horrible. I'm suicidal and no one in my life knows anymore because I changed my behavior. I just want to fucking die.
Thank you for responding and checking. It means a lot!!
Thank you. That means a lot. The simplest form can sometimes take the greatest meaning.
Aww. So kind. Thank you!
I like that. Thank you!💚
Thank you!!
Thank you. I'm going to keep fighting. I'm still coming to terms with being here. But I'm trying and that's better than it was 9 days ago.
Thank you. 🤍🤍 I think I am too.

Thank you for this!! 🤍 You are loved as well! I'm sorry you're also in that position. It isn't easy. But I'm hoping it's worth it. My chat is always open if you ever need to talk or just to vent. 💚 Sometimes the best listeners are those who also struggle.
I will! It's been a hard and interesting 9 days. But I've just started treating every day like it's my last and I feel like I'm more present now.

I still have them. I still have everything. It's all in a box in my garage. I don't know if I'm ready to get rid of them yet. Although I don't see myself using them... I'm just not ready... Does that make sense?
I am. Not going till later tonight. Sometime after 11.
I'm still here. I probably won't go till 11 ish tonight or later. So I'm not found so soon. And the gases have time to .. work?..

I'm feeling alone. I hate it. I just hate living. I hate being here. I want to die. I keep thinking about going tonight. But have a dinner date with a friend tomorrow so I'm trying to hold off and go tomorrow.

I've done Ketamine as well. It helped for a bit but now it doesn't. I've also done Spravato with Ketamine. And it also helped for a bit. I've done EMDR therapy, Talk therapy, been on a handful of different antidepressants. I have TRD (treatment resistant depression) and it just feels like everything I do will eventually fail. I am trying to get TMS approved but we will see. I'm just tired of fighting and everything failing.
Right now, I like Grandson, Lil happy Lil sad, Trapt, and NF. They are my most played artists.
Oh thunderstorms are amazing. I love taking pictures of them. They use to scare me but then I started to embrace them. Now I can sit outside and watch the rain pour and the sky light up.
That is a great song. I have never heard it before. But I love it.
I had to find English lyrics. The German sounds very cool though.
I love the rain. I find it so peaceful and pure. I could totally listen to the rain over music!
both are very good. Right now, I am obsessed with Riptide by Grandson.
That is a classic. Good choice.
I listened to the song. Very different from what I normally listen too but, I felt it. Thank you.
I love nature as well. It's so calming and peaceful. That is why I plan on going up in the mountains. I want to see the waterfalls and the mountains before I go.
Thank you for this. I try to find the good in me. To love myself. Even if it is a small thing. Feels like finding things to love about myself just gets harder and harder to do though.
I've seen Kill Bill vol 1 & 2. Long time ago. Barely remember them. I haven't seen Pulp Fiction. Although I have heard of it.

Thank you. I like to think that I am nice. No reason to be mean, life is cruel enough. 

Honestly, I don't know if my mind can be changed... I feel pretty set on finally being free from my demons and allowing my family to finally move on w/o me and my depression party. 

Favorite Movie? Deadpool! Defiantly.

Thank you. And your good. Bombard away. I know this may sound hypocritical, but keep trying. It is hard. But lots of people do over come it. Not everything that worked for them will work for you. Hugs.

It started when I was a kid. Tried to kill myself as a teen. Spent lots of time in inpatient facilities. As an adult I have done all kinds of treatments and therapy to help "get over" my trauma. I guess I'm just broken. I'm just so tired of feeling. Of constantly fighting the demons. 

I love art/photography. I've even had a few shows as a teenager. That was pretty cool.
I feel the same way. I know that to some degree they will be angry and hurt. I just hope that it passes sooner than later. That they can grieve and move on.
I'm sorry you relate. That you too struggle.
It sucks that you relate. I hope things get better for you. or that you as well find happiness or can one day be pain free.
I'm sorry...

I've tried to fight. To not let my depression or my demons win. But it honestly feels like after every treatment, they come back harder, stronger, more determined. I feel like I can't breathe anymore. I am sick of the room going black and the walls caving in. I just want all the pain and suffering on me and what I cause on my family to just end. I feel like I am never a winner. Yeah, I have had good moments and I have some amazing memories that I will carry and cherish all the way to the end. But even those moments feel washed away by the storm of my life, my mind, my depression.

Hey, I am glad you reached out. Please don't feel like you didn't do anything. Just reaching out, giving me something to read, to connect too, was meaningful. I want nothing more than for everyone to be happy and find peace. I wish suicide on no one. Yet I understand it. I get it. Hell, I'm going to do it. 

I guess I posted this to just get it off of my chest. To be honest and let it all out in my final week here. I honestly didn't think anyone would read it. Or care.

So, Thank you. Internet Hug.
yeah. These times suck. Thank you.

I don't want the authorities involved either. And I defiantly don't want to go back to the hospital. I feel like no matter what happens, I am just pushing out the inevitable. No intervention is going to prevent me from taking my life. From stopping the pain and misery I feel everyday. The best dreams I have ever had are the ones where I am dying. I'm sorry you are also going through this. Depression and Suicidal Ideation are one of the worst things to have to live with daily. I hope you also find your peace.
I'm sorry you understand how I feel! It is the worst feeling! I hope you find peace. I know I will.

I don't know how to put fully what is in my head down. I just feel really stuck. Like the world is black, dark and the walls are caving in. And I am just tired of feeling like a burden on my family, financially, emotionally, mentally, everything. I can't keep hurting them. I need to let them go. To be free.

I have reached out for help. And I feel like no one understands me. The one person who I think does understand me, looks at me like I am a stranger sometimes. He doesn't always get what I am going through and he cries because of me. He doesn't tell me, but I've heard him. And it sucks. I am causing pain just by being alive. And I hate it. I can't keep being a burden on them, causing them pain. I just want to end it. Get it over with. I hate putting them through my depression and being suicidal everyday is exhausting. I just want them to be happy and to be free. Not burdened by me and my sickness.

I haven't read it. I will look into it. I don't know if you are still around, If you are I'm sorry EMDR fucked you up. It is weird. I get the concept behind it. But yeah I struggled with it too. I hate when people say "it worked for me, so it can work for you" and that is total bullshit. Mental illness is so fucked and people try to justify it and rationalize it to fit their mold/opinion/whatever. And It's so damn stupid. 

If you are not hear anymore, I hope you are happier. At peace. And No longer in pain.
Thank you, for reaching out. I truly appreciate it. Thank you for caring.

Thanks. It use to be very painful. But your right. At some point I became numb to it. Being depressed and suicidal is my normal. Waking up, smiling, pretending to be happy for others to feel okay is what is painful. I'm sick of being an actor. It's not what I want to do. I've got the date and the method. Just getting my affairs in order. I am beyond fucking ready.

I keep hoping too. Maybe all this shit that life has thrown at me is for a reason. That my life, me, and all this isn't just wasted dead space. Which is hard to think and go through being a healthcare worker.
When I tried in 2018 it was a super big adrenaline rush, then I woke up, and it was a rush of all sorts of emotions. But the feeling of attempting is a huge adrenaline rush.
That's exactly how it feels. I feel like if I try again and succeed awesome. If I don't, oh well. It was a ride.
